messages:
Maya Chen: AcmeCorp pinging — sudden 503/504s on /v1/generate since ~14:05 UTC, ~10% of requests failing. They say SDK v0.9.3 with default retries hitting a loop. Ticket #INC-2026.
Zach Rivera: Can you paste a minimal repro + headers? Any pattern (large prompts, streaming vs non)?
Maya Chen: Small repro attached: non-stream generate, 3KB prompt, single region us-west1. Headers show Authorization + x-client-id. SDK log snippet: "error=504 upstream read timeout, attempt=2". No spikes on model runtime CPU.
Priya Patel: Also seeing auth token refresh fanout around same minute in logs. Could be token-rotation + session eviction causing ingress h2 window stalls.
Omar Khan: I can see ingress errors 14:04:57-14:06:10. h2 window_update spikes and RESET_STREAMs from front proxy. Possible keepalive/conn reuse issue with edge pool.
Jin Park: Quick repro curl I used:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout (after ~15s)
support-bot: New alert routed to eng-sre. Link: https://internal/alerts/INC-2026
Zach Rivera: Mitigation options: 1) Ask customer to disable aggressive SDK retries (v0.9.3 uses exponential backoff but tight window). 2) Temporarily route their org to fallback model variant (lower concurrency). 3) SRE can add short ingress draining to evict stale h2 sessions.
Maya Chen: I told customer to set env REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=1 and to use non-streaming momentarily. Waiting on them to confirm. Also offered fallback to model redwood-1-small.
Omar Khan: I'll check front proxy metrics and increase h2 window size + tweak keepalive for us-west1 edge pool. Opening SRE ticket SRE-1147.
Priya Patel: From auth side: their token refresh pattern showed 300 concurrent refreshes in a 10s window — likely auth-fanout. Adding rate limiting on refresh tokens could help.
Jin Park: For repro, here's a short python snippet that reproduces locally (sdk v0.9.3):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="...")
for i in range(20):
    try:
        print(c.generate(model="redwood-1", input="x"))
    except Exception as e:
        print("err", e)
```
Zach Rivera: Eng-sre, please correlate ingress RESET_STREAMs with tenant id acmecorp-123. Prioritize if error rate > 5%.
Omar Khan: On it. Temp mitigation: enabled per-tenant connection cap and reduced concurrency for acmecorp-123 at the edge. Monitoring.
Maya Chen: Customer updated: setting REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=1 now, switching to small model if issues persist. They're ok with fallback for the next 2 hours.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of ingress tweak scheduled at 14:40 UTC — rolling 3/5 edge nodes.
Priya Patel: Assigning follow-up: auth team to add token refresh throttle and support to confirm rollback plan. I'll draft comms to customer summarizing root cause hypotheses and temporary mitigations.
Maya Chen: Thanks — will close INC-2026 after 2h stable. If SRE sees resets stop after deploy, we'll send final note.
Zach Rivera: Good. Keep thread updated with metrics: p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate for acmecorp-123.
Maya Chen: Noted. I'll paste metrics once stable. :thumbsup:
